title: BALWIK Magazine
summary: Covers and inside pages for a monthly community magazine, from its first issue on.

stats.label: designed from the very first issue

caseStudy.brief: BALWIK, a new community news magazine in Quezon province, needed a look for its monthly issues, starting with Volume 1, Number 1 in September 2021.
caseStudy.did: As Layout Artist I designed the covers and inside pages of each issue: cover stories, features, interviews, editorials and opinion columns.
decisions: Every cover is built around one strong portrait and a short cover line, so the magazine is recognisable from issue to issue.
A consistent grid and colour-coded section heads help readers move between news, features and opinion.
Large pull-quote titles give long reads a strong way in, in both English and Filipino.
